newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore government securities end narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore government securities end narrowly mixed.

text.p: Singapore government securities ended narrowly mixed on Thursday in moderate trade on retail and interbank interest, dealers said.
"Government securities were narrowly mixed today on lack of fresh factors and amid uncertainty over the near-term direction of the market. Volume was moderate," a local dealer said.
In treasury bills, three-months closed at a yield of 1.73/1.68 percent compared with Wednesday's yield of 1.70/1.65 percent, and one-year at a yield of 1.65/1.60 percent against 1.60/1.55 percent.
Among bonds, July 1998 ended at S$99.25/99.30 from Wednesday's close of S$99.31/99.36, September 2001 at S$99.38/99.43 versus S$99.41/99.46 and June 2003 at S$99.04/99.09 against S$99.08/99.13.
The overnight interbank offered rate was unchanged from Wednesday's 2-3/4 2-5/8 percent.
